items.teaser: Russian forces struck a critical infrastructure facility in Dnipro.

items.teaser: The meeting came as Russia intensifies its ballistic missile and drone attacks on Kyiv and elsewhere across Ukraine, posing an immense challenge to the Ukrainian air defense.

items.title: Russia attacks critical infrastructure in Dnipro, causing power cuts
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked a critical infrastructure facility in Dnipro.

items.title: Zelensky discusses next steps toward just peace with Støre in Norway
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky held another meeting with Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre in Oslo, saying that further progress toward peace would depend on whether Russia presents the United States with new proposals for peace rather than for continuing the war.

items.title: First diesel tanker to depart for U.S. on Thursday, Russia says

items.title: NABU berichtet von Durchsuchungen bei der NBU und in der Wohnung eines der Bankmitarbeiter
items.teaser: Das Nationale Antikorruptionsbüro (NABU) führt unter der verfahrensrechtlichen Leitung der Spezialisierten Antikorruptionsstaatsanwaltschaft (SAP) Durchsuchungen in den Räumlichkeiten der Nationalbank der Ukraine (NBU) sowie am Wohnort eines Mitarbeiters durch.

items.title: Ukraine’s capitulation would amount to the capitulation of us all, Merz says
items.teaser: Supporting Ukraine serves Germany’s own interests and aims to end Russia’s war of aggression as soon as possible. Ukraine’s capitulation is unacceptable, as it would amount to the capitulation of all its European partners.

items.title: Three Ukrainian universities damaged in overnight Russian attack
items.teaser: Three Ukrainian universities in Uman, Kremenchuk, and Kyiv were damaged in a Russian attack overnight.

items.teaser: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has criticized the Lviv Regional Council’s decision to declare 2027 the Year of the Ukrainian Insurgent Army (UPA) and Roman Shukhevych, saying the move harms Ukraine and complicates Polish-Ukrainian cooperation.

items.teaser: Russland hat den US-Bürger Stephen Hubbard freigelassen. Das bestätigten Präsident Putin und US-Unterhändler Witkoff. Hubbard war 2024 in Moskau wegen angeblichem "Söldnertum" für die Ukraine zu einer Haftstrafe von fast sieben Jahren verurteilt worden.

items.title: Krisen-Vorbereitung ist große Herausforderung für Krankenhäuser

items.title: Azov dismisses Russian claim of capturing Dobropillia
items.teaser: The First Corps of Ukraine’s National Guard, Azov, has dismissed Russian claims that Russian forces captured Dobropillia, calling them disinformation.

items.teaser: The two sides do not agree even on which service was capped.

items.title: Russian drones strike Kyiv hospital, injure 5 across the city
items.teaser: Ukrainian Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said Russia struck the operating room of the Strazheska Institute of the National Academy of Medical Sciences in Kyiv, injuring one patient.

items.title: DIU fighters clear 600 hectares of forest in Sumy region, thwart Russian offensive
items.teaser: Fighters from the Group 10 special operations unit have foiled Russian invasion forces’ offensive plans and prevented them from cutting off logistical routes during a special operation in the Sumy region.

items.title: Zelensky meets Trump envoy Witkoff in Norway as US-Ukraine ties sour
items.teaser: Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store and Finnish President Alexander Stubb are also taking part in the talks.

items.title: Budanov denies Russian claims of capturing Dobropillia
items.teaser: Dobropillia in the Zaporizhzhia region remains under Ukrainian control, Russian forces have not captured the city.

items.title: Ukraine's High Anti-Corruption Court confiscates 79 wagons belonging to Russian businessman Gamzalov
items.teaser: Ukraine's High Anti-Corruption Court has confiscated 79 wagons controlled by Russian businessman Stanislav Gamzalov for the benefit of the state.

items.title: Neue Arktisstrategie - EU will in mehr Eisbrecher und Unterseekabel investieren
items.teaser: Die Europäische Union will ihre Präsenz in der Arktis ausweiten. EU-Kommissionspräsidentin von der Leyen sagte bei der Vorstellung einer Arktisstrategie in Brüssel, es werde in eine stärkere Sicherheit und eine widerstandsfähige Infrastruktur investiert.

items.title: Zelenskyy meets King of Norway – video
items.teaser: The Ukrainian president met King Haakon at the Royal Palace in Oslo, ahead of talks with US envoy Steve Witkoff, Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre and Finnish President Alexander Stubb on ending the war.

items.title: Ein Toter und sieben Verletzte nach russischen Angriffen in Kyjiw seit Tagesbeginn
items.teaser: Bei russischen Drohnenangriffen in Kyjiw sind ein Mensch getötet und mindestens sieben weitere Menschen verletzt worden, teilt die Leiterin des Departements für Gesundheitswesen der Kyjiwer Stadtverwaltung, Tetjana Mostepan, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Data center in occupied Donetsk destroyed, expert says
items.teaser: Ukraine has increasingly used long-range strikes and strikes against data centers to weaken Russia's ability to sustain the war.

items.title: A diesel tank burns at Transneft’s Druzhba hub as Ukraine keeps striking Russian energy despite Trump’s pressure
items.teaser: Russia’s state pipeline monopoly has said nothing, and the local governor described the site only as an enterprise, while residents posted video of the flames.

items.title: Rubio: Ukraine interceptor deliveries may have been delayed, but not for political reasons
items.teaser: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said on Tuesday that a batch of interceptors purchased for Ukraine under the Prioritised Ukraine Requirements List (PURL) program may not have been delivered, but that this was not because of any political intent.

items.title: Russian general lying to Putin about "capture" of Dobropillia, which remains unoccupied – head of Zelenskyy's office
items.teaser: Kyrylo Budanov states that a Russian general is deliberately misinforming Vladimir Putin about the capture of Dobropillia, which is under Ukrainian control.

items.title: More ballistic missile interceptors and F-16 repairs inside Ukraine: Kyiv’s two asks to Lockheed Martin
items.teaser: The talks came as a batch of Patriot missiles that allies have already paid for awaits a Pentagon signature, Ukrainian officials say.

items.title: Schlupflöcher schließen: Rat listet Personen und Organisationen wegen Umgehung von EU-Sanktionen
items.teaser: Der Rat hat restriktive Maßnahmen gegen drei Personen und neun Organisationen erlassen, die an der Einfuhr von mit Sanktionen belegten Gütern nach Russland und an der Umgehung von Sanktionen im Zusammenhang mit Erdöl und Finanztransaktionen beteiligt sind.

items.title: Russia recruits around 1,800 foreign nationals every month
items.teaser: Ukraine has identified 45,959 foreign nationals from 151 countries who signed contracts with Russia’s military. Recruitment is rising fastest in Africa and Latin America, with 16,168 foreigners enlisted in the first nine months of 2026.

items.title: EU to bolster tracking of Russian shadow fleet and hybrid attacks with new Arctic Strategy
items.teaser: "When we see Russia rebuilding its Arctic military footprint, pursuing hybrid strategies against its neighbors, and reshaping the security of the Arctic, it impacts the EU as a whole," said European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen.

items.title: Russian drone attacks kill one, injure seven in Kyiv
items.teaser: As of 14:45 on Tuesday, October 20, seven people were injured in Russian attacks in Kyiv, and one person was killed.

items.title: Arne Bartram, ARD Stockholm, zzt. Oslo, über das Treffen von Selenskyj mit Witkoff in Norwegen
items.teaser: Arne Bartram, ARD Stockholm, zzt. Oslo, über das Treffen von Selenskyj mit Witkoff in Norwegen

items.title: Selenskyj in Norwegen eingetroffen
items.teaser: Der ukrainische Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj ist zu Gesprächen mit dem US- Sondergesandten Steve Witkoff in Norwegen eingetroffen.

items.title: Russians attack Kyiv Oblast yet again: two injured, fire at logistics complex
items.teaser: Two people have been injured and a fire broke out at a logistics complex due to a Russian drone strike on Kyiv Oblast on 20 October.

items.title: Ukrainians in U.S. protest easing of sanctions on Russian diesel fuel
items.teaser: Ukrainian activists in Los Angeles, Chicago, San Diego and Seattle held rallies to protest against the policies of the Donald Trump administration regarding Russian diesel fuel, while also advocating for the continuation of defense aid to Ukraine.

items.title: Russian drone kills six in Kharkiv Oblast park, including mother and her 14-month-old in a stroller. Hours later, Ukraine shows photos to US senators
items.teaser: A Russian drone strike killed two children and four adults, while 15 people, including seven children, were injured, a local official said.

items.title: Russischer Angriff auf Lagerhäuser nahe Dnipro: zwei Personen tot geborgen
items.teaser: Bei einem russischen Angriff auf das Umland der Stadt Dnipro sind zwei Menschen ums Leben gekommen. Ihre Leichen wurden während der Aufräumarbeiten geborgen, teilt der Leiter der regionalen Militärverwaltung, Oleksandr Hanzha, auf Telegram mit.

items.title: Ukrainian drone forces strike rare Russian BREM-1 armoured vehicle in Zaporizhzhia Oblast – video
items.teaser: The Russians fitted an armoured recovery vehicle with electronic warfare equipment and anti-drone cages, but it was still hit by Ukraine’s Raid regiment. The vehicle was used to recover and repair damaged tanks and other heavy equipment.

items.title: 31 in May, 63 now: Ukraine’s arms makers pile into a regime of tax breaks and shielded data
items.teaser: The 32 firms that joined since May bring under a quarter of the early members’ average weapons revenue, by Euromaidan Press calculations.

items.title: Data center attacked overnight in Russian-occupied Donetsk
items.teaser: A data center was attacked overnight in Russian-occupied Donetsk; telephone services, internet access and telecommunications infrastructure were damaged.

items.title: Russia’s Rubicon hunts Ukrainian drone pilots. In Vivaldi, it became the target, and its morale fell sharply, says the Ukrainian general
items.teaser: Biletskyi noted his corps spent drones without limit on every Rubicon position it found. As the operation ends, he hands the Third Corps to an acting commander.

items.title: Trümmer einer russischen Drohne stürzen auf Dach einer medizinischen Einrichtung in Kyjiw ab
items.teaser: Im Solomyanskyj Bezirk von Kyjiw sind Trümmer einer russische Drohne auf das Dach einer medizinischen Einrichtung abgestürzt, teilt die Kyjiwer Stadtverwaltung auf Telegram mit.

items.title: President Zelensky arrives in Norway
items.teaser: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived in Norway, where he is scheduled to meet with Steve Witkoff, among other engagements.

items.title: Wie Drohnenattacken Russlands digitalen Alltag treffen
items.teaser: Die Ukraine greift vermehrt Rechenzentren in Russland an - etwa von Yandex, dem wichtigsten Digitalkonzern des Landes. Die Reparaturen dürften Monate dauern.

items.title: Rubio outraged by claims US no longer warns Ukraine of ballistic threats
items.teaser: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has dismissed claims that the United States has deliberately stopped providing Ukraine with warnings about Russian ballistic threats.

items.title: Ukrainian expedition completes search in Poland’s Lasków, remains of more than 40 people found
items.teaser: Search operations at an Orthodox cemetery in the village of Lasków, in Poland’s Lublin Voivodeship, have been completed, with the expedition uncovering the remains of more than 40 people.

items.title: Ukrainische Verteidigungskräfte treffen feindliche Militärlager und Kommandozentrale einer russischen Armeeeinheit
items.teaser: Am 19. und in der Nacht zum 20. Oktober griffen die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte noch eine Reihe russischer Militärobjekte an, darunter Lager für materiell-technische Mittel bei Kripenske (Gebiet Luhansk), Riwnopillja (Gebiet Donezk) und Lahidne (Oblast Saporischschja).

items.title: Poland has no Patriot missiles left for Ukraine, Sikorski says
items.teaser: Sikorski said that the shortage of missiles had worsened after the attacks on Iran.

items.title: Rubio insists delays in interceptor deliveries to Kyiv are not deliberate
items.teaser: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio has said there has been no change to weapons supplies to Ukraine under the PURL initiative or to intelligence sharing, attributing delays in interceptor deliveries to global demand.

items.title: Restoration work begins on dome of St. Sophia’s Cathedral in Kyiv
items.teaser: Restoration work has begun on the southeastern dome of St. Sophia’s Cathedral in Kyiv.

items.title: EU's chief diplomat: US negotiators have been pushing Ukraine towards surrender for almost two years
items.teaser: Kaja Kallas, EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, states that Europe's support prevented Ukraine from surrendering under US pressure.

items.title: Zelenskyy arrives in Norway for peace talks
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy arrived in Oslo on 20 October for crucial negotiations with Trump's special envoys and European government leaders

items.title: South Korea to withdraw some diplomatic staff from Ukraine amid POW dispute
items.teaser: "This measure was taken because ​we judged it necessary to facilitate an amicable resolution of the ‌issue ⁠and restore trust between the two countries," said Park Doo-soon, a spokesperson for South Korea's Foreign Ministry, according to Yonhap.

items.title: Russians strike shopping centre in Rivne Oblast, injuring three
items.teaser: Three people have been injured, two of whom were taken to hospital, following a Russian attack on a shopping centre in Ukraine's Rivne Oblast on 20 October.

items.title: Anti-Terror-Einheit ermittelt: Linksradikaler wegen Rathausbrand in Limoges festgenommen
items.teaser: Es ist das Symbol der Gewaltexzesse in Frankreich: In Limoges wird das prächtige Rathaus bei schweren Krawallen völlig zerstört. Nun gelingt französischen Sicherheitskräften immerhin ein Fahndungserfolg.

items.title: Three civilians injured as Russian forces attack shopping center in Rivne region
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a shopping center in the Rivne region, injuring three people.

items.title: No warning, capped Starlink, unsigned Patriots: Zelenskyy lists US holds to senators as Kyiv reads them as pressure
items.teaser: He said he offered US envoys a 30-day pause on refinery strikes in exchange for Patriots. A US official disputed Kyiv’s account of the Patriot hold.

items.title: Ukraine finally voted to tax cheap foreign parcels to unlock €3.7 billion—now Brussels decides whether it was enough, with a €70 billion gap ahead amid ongoing war
items.teaser: Parliament needed three tries to pass the tax, and nobody has yet signed up to pay the bigger bill for Russia’s war in 2027.

items.title: Kyiv medical facility roof damaged by Russian drone debris
items.teaser: Emergency services have responded after Russian drone debris hit the top floor of a medical facility in Solomianskyi district amidst ongoing air attacks on Kyiv.

items.title: Russian forces attack warehouses in Zaporizhzhia, three injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked warehouse facilities in Zaporizhzhia, injuring three people.

items.title: Russische Besatzungsarmee beschießt Kramatorsk: Drei Zivilisten getötet, zwei weitere verletzt
items.teaser: Die russische Besatzungsarmee hat die Stadt Kramatorsk erneut beschossen. Dabei wurden drei Zivilisten getötet und zwei weitere verletzt.

items.title: Hungary blocks next step in EU membership bids of Ukraine, Moldova, no explanation given
items.teaser: Colleagues asked their Hungarian counterparts to explain their position, but they did not, one diplomat said.

items.title: Zelensky's trust rating surges amid Trump's pressure campaign, poll finds
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump has repeatedly criticized Zelensky, saying Ukraine should consider finding someone else to negotiate on its behalf.

items.title: EU and NATO to be represented by von der Leyen and Rutte's team members at Oslo talks - European Pravda
items.teaser: Björn Seibert and Lorenz Meyer-Minnemann will represent the EU and NATO at the upcoming peace talks in Oslo, joining Volodymyr Zelenskyy and US envoys.

items.title: Selenskyj trifft sich mit US-Gesandtem Witkoff zu Gesprächen in Oslo
items.teaser: In Oslo kommt der ukrainische Präsident Selenskyj mit dem US-Gesandten Witkoff zu Gesprächen zusammen. Zuletzt hatten sich die Beziehungen zwischen den USA der Ukraine wegen Trumps Umgang mit Russland wieder verschlechtert.

items.title: At least 14 killed, 71 injured in Russian attacks across Ukraine over past day as Russian drone kills 2 children in park
items.teaser: On the night of Oct. 20, Russia attacked Ukraine with 165 Shahed-type and other drones, 105 of them jet-powered, Ukraine's Air Force said.

items.title: Russian forces shell Kramatorsk: three civilians killed, two more injured
items.teaser: Russian forces shelled Kramatorsk again, killing three civilians and injuring two others.

items.title: Russians attack Oldi hypermarket in Zhytomyr Oblast
items.teaser: The Oldi store in Zhytomyr at 9 Vitruka Street has temporarily closed following a Russian attack.

items.title: Zelenskyy to join Norway talks, after which Trump's envoy will fly to Moscow – Axios
items.teaser: Following joint Oslo talks with President Zelenskyy and European allies, US envoy Steve Witkoff plans to present peace proposals to Vladimir Putin in Moscow.

items.title: Ukrainische Drohnen attackieren Ölpumpstation in Region Tambow
items.teaser: In der Nacht zum Dienstag, dem 20. Oktober, griffen Drohnen die lineare Produktions- und Verteilstation „Nikolskoje“ nahe der russischen Stadt Michurinsk in der Region Tambow an.

items.title: Mariupol defender publishes ‘Satan’s Sanatorium’, written with chicken bone on prison garb in captivity
items.teaser: A collection of poems titled “Satan’s Sanatorium” by Andrii Petruk, a serviceman of the 36th Marine Brigade and defender of Mariupol, has been published. He wrote the poems with a chicken bone on prison garb while in Russian captivity.

items.title: Witkoff arrives in Oslo for meeting with Zelenskyy
items.teaser: US President Donald Trump’s special envoy Steve Witkoff has arrived in Oslo, where he is due to hold talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

items.title: Lithuania’s armed forces chief says patrols on the Kaliningrad border have practically doubled as the troop mission runs into mid-November
items.teaser: Raimundas Vaikšnoras links the deployment to what he calls Russian preparations for a large-scale mobilization, saying Moscow lacks people for Ukraine.

items.title: Three killed and two injured in Russian attack on Kramatorsk
items.teaser: Russian attack has targeted Kramatorsk, damaging three multi-story residential buildings and causing multiple civilian casualties.

items.title: Ukraine’s Defense Forces strike Russian military depots, command post
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces struck a number of Russian military targets on October 19 and overnight into October 20, including logistics depots in the areas of Kripenske in the Luhansk region, Rivnopil in the Donetsk region, and Lahidne in the Zaporizhzhia region.

items.title: Trump will Selenskyj als Präsidenten weghaben
items.teaser: Der US-Republikaner legt nach: Die Ukraine gebe den Vereinigten Staaten nichts zurück - obwohl sie viel empfangen habe. Und deren Präsident sei bei den Friedensbemühungen "keine echte Hilfe".

items.title: "An der Zeit": Trump will Selenskyj als Präsidenten der Ukraine weghaben
items.teaser: Der US-Republikaner legt nach: Die Ukraine gebe den Vereinigten Staaten nichts zurück - obwohl sie viel empfangen habe. Und ihr Präsident sei bei den Friedensbemühungen "keine echte Hilfe".

items.title: Defence forces strike Russian command post, repair unit and warehouses – Ukraine's General Staff
items.teaser: Ukraine's defence forces struck a Russian command post, repair unit, logistics warehouses and troop concentrations in occupied parts of Zaporizhzhia, Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts

items.title: Ukraine has identified nearly 46,000 foreigners from 151 countries in Russia’s army—and says Moscow is on pace to meet its 2026 hiring plan
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of POWs says this year’s contracts already roughly match all of 2025, while new names keep surfacing from earlier years.

items.title: Russian drones attacking energy infrastructure in Vinnytsia region, causing power outages
items.teaser: Russian drones are attacking energy infrastructure in the Vinnytsia region, causing power outages.

items.title: Power outages in 12 regions after Russian assault on Ukraine's power plants
items.teaser: To avoid overloading previously damaged equipment, power limitation schedules for industry will be applied across all of Ukraine, as well as hourly outage schedules in some regions, Ukrenergo announced.

items.title: An der Front 206 Stürme gemeldet, Russen machen Druck in Richtung Piwdennosloboschansk
items.teaser: An der Front kam es am vergangenen Tag, dem 19. Oktober, zu 206 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Streitkräften und den russischen Besatzern, ließ auf Facebook der Generalstab der ukrainischen Streitkräfte zur Lage an der Front am Freitag, dem 20. Oktober, melden.

items.title: Kallas calls for moratorium on strikes in Black Sea
items.teaser: EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Kaja Kallas has called for increased pressure on Russia and for freedom of navigation to be ensured in the Black Sea.

items.title: Poland considers joint border controls with Ukraine on Polish side of border
items.teaser: The Polish Ministry of Interior has announced readiness to implement joint border operations on Polish territory with Ukraine, pending Schengen notifications and security needs.
